Ava Morgan: BrightLeaf (BL-231) reports ~1.7k missing embeddings on March invoice after AZ failover ~03:12 UTC. Requesting provisional credit and backfill. @Ravi @Sofia
Ravi Patel: any idea if lost in ingest or collapsed by rate limiter? rough $?
Ava Morgan: counts: expected 18,942 vs stored 17,210 -> 1,732 missing. At $0.20/1k = $0.3464 -> round $0.35. Query I ran: SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings_store WHERE customer_id='BL-231' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15';
Joel Chen: infra update: AZ failover triggered retries and our ip-rate-limiter had a 15s dedupe window that collapsed retries into one. We've shortened the window; need a cluster-wide scan for 03:00-03:30 UTC. Ava please open infra ticket.
Sofia Li: Finance action: GL-4420 memo: "Credit - embed undercount - INV-2026-042 - BrightLeaf". Suggested adjustment: "Credit $0.35 to BrightLeaf (BL-231) for 1,732 missing embeddings. Root cause: AZ failover + rate limiter dedupe. Ticket FIN-3892."
FinOps Bot: Created FIN-3892: "BrightLeaf embed undercount during AZ failover" assigned to Ava Morgan. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/FIN-3892
Ravi Patel: provisional approve :white_check_mark: pending infra confirmation and cross-customer scan. Run cluster scan and post results.
Ava Morgan: will apply provisional negative invoice line now and run the scan; will follow with a backfill if replay finds rows. Sofia please prepare GL entry and hold final close until scan done.
Sofia Li: ack 94 will post ledger entry id when recorded.
